title: core-js: rename the function-uncurry-this internal module
prompt: This is a copy of the core-js 3.50.0 package (the polyfill modules, their shared internal helpers and the entry points; plain CommonJS). Rename the internal helper module `function-uncurry-this` to `function-uncurry-receiver`: move the file and update every require of it, wherever it is required from (internals, modules and the entry-point directories). The two neighbouring modules whose names merely start the same way, `function-uncurry-this-accessor` and `function-uncurry-this-clause`, are different modules and must keep their names and keep working. Local variable names are out of scope. Every module and entry point must still load.
